title: Operator-only rootless Docker syntax smoke for live-host preflight
summary: Adds a disabled-by-default two-flag operator CLI that exercises the existing P00 rootless syntax-only broker on fixed harmless valid/invalid Python source, verifies sanitized receipts and refuses model-controlled Docker or GitHub writes. Cross-platform mocked tests do not prove real user-host isolation.
migration_notes: No released product data migration. Operator must separately install, verify and opt in to the dedicated Linux rootless runtime; command remains deny-by-default.
